reason: A browser review interface for visualizing session file changes as live line-level diffs, with session and turn views plus direct file reversion.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中按会话和轮次查看文件写入与编辑的实时行级差异，并支持撤回变更。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows session and turn-level file edits as live line-by-line diffs and supports reverting changes.

capabilities: Tracks file write and edit operations within sessions
Stores before-and-after file content and review records on disk
Displays line-level diffs and live update events in a browser UI
Reverts individual changes or whole files by writing directly to disk
Opens files in selected editors or reveals them in the file manager
